svg.text: GeeNet - Self Test

text.font-family: ui-monospace, 'Cascadia Mono', 'Segoe UI Mono', Consolas, 'DejaVu Sans Mono', monospace

svg.text: [ok] A. Healthy connection -> Healthy/Pass

text.font-family: ui-monospace, 'Cascadia Mono', 'Segoe UI Mono', Consolas, 'DejaVu Sans Mono', monospace

svg.text: [ok] B. Network adapter disconnected -> Link/Fail

text.font-family: ui-monospace, 'Cascadia Mono', 'Segoe UI Mono', Consolas, 'DejaVu Sans Mono', monospace

svg.text: [ok] C. No usable IP address (169.254 self-assigned) -> IP/Fail

text.font-family: ui-monospace, 'Cascadia Mono', 'Segoe UI Mono', Consolas, 'DejaVu Sans Mono', monospace

svg.text: [ok] D. No default gateway configured -> Gateway/Fail

text.font-family: ui-monospace, 'Cascadia Mono', 'Segoe UI Mono', Consolas, 'DejaVu Sans Mono', monospace

svg.text: [ok] E. Router (gateway) unreachable -> LocalNet/Fail

text.font-family: ui-monospace, 'Cascadia Mono', 'Segoe UI Mono', Consolas, 'DejaVu Sans Mono', monospace

svg.text: [ok] F. Internet unreachable although the router answers -> Upstream/Fail

text.font-family: ui-monospace, 'Cascadia Mono', 'Segoe UI Mono', Consolas, 'DejaVu Sans Mono', monospace

svg.text: [ok] G. DNS does not resolve names (internet by IP works) -> DNS/Fail

text.font-family: ui-monospace, 'Cascadia Mono', 'Segoe UI Mono', Consolas, 'DejaVu Sans Mono', monospace

svg.text: [ok] H. Web (HTTPS) traffic broken, ping and DNS fine -> HTTPS/Fail

text.font-family: ui-monospace, 'Cascadia Mono', 'Segoe UI Mono', Consolas, 'DejaVu Sans Mono', monospace

svg.text: [ok] I. Only one application fails (Teams) -> Application/Fail

text.font-family: ui-monospace, 'Cascadia Mono', 'Segoe UI Mono', Consolas, 'DejaVu Sans Mono', monospace

svg.text: [ok] J. Only this computer fails (other devices are fine) -> IP/Fail

text.font-family: ui-monospace, 'Cascadia Mono', 'Segoe UI Mono', Consolas, 'DejaVu Sans Mono', monospace

svg.text: [ok] K. Whole network has no internet -> Upstream/Fail

text.font-family: ui-monospace, 'Cascadia Mono', 'Segoe UI Mono', Consolas, 'DejaVu Sans Mono', monospace

svg.text: [ok] L. Laptop on Wi-Fi with the cable unplugged -> Healthy/Pass

text.font-family: ui-monospace, 'Cascadia Mono', 'Segoe UI Mono', Consolas, 'DejaVu Sans Mono', monospace

svg.text: [ok] M. DNS answers very slowly -> DNSSlow/Warn

text.font-family: ui-monospace, 'Cascadia Mono', 'Segoe UI Mono', Consolas, 'DejaVu Sans Mono', monospace

svg.text: [ok] N. Wi-Fi adapter present but nothing connected -> Link/Fail

text.font-family: ui-monospace, 'Cascadia Mono', 'Segoe UI Mono', Consolas, 'DejaVu Sans Mono', monospace

svg.text: [ok] W. Weak Wi-Fi signal -> Latency/Warn

text.font-family: ui-monospace, 'Cascadia Mono', 'Segoe UI Mono', Consolas, 'DejaVu Sans Mono', monospace

svg.text: [ok] S. Packet loss on the way to the internet -> PacketLoss/Fail

text.font-family: ui-monospace, 'Cascadia Mono', 'Segoe UI Mono', Consolas, 'DejaVu Sans Mono', monospace

svg.text: [ok] X. Windows network services stopped -> Services/Fail

text.font-family: ui-monospace, 'Cascadia Mono', 'Segoe UI Mono', Consolas, 'DejaVu Sans Mono', monospace

svg.text: [ok] P. Wi-Fi link is fine, no internet, other devices are fine too -> Upstream/Fail

svg.text: [ok] V. VPN tunnel is up and the internet stopped working -> VPN/Fail

svg.text: [ok] R. Connection is slow (high latency, no packet loss) -> Latency/Warn
